bib.title: GSM-Symbolic: Understanding the Limitations of Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models

legacy_report:
SOURCE: "GSM-Symbolic: Understanding the Limitations of Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models", Mirzadeh, Alizadeh, Shahrokhi, Tuzel, Bengio, Farajtabar (Apple; Washington State University). Printed header: "Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025". arXiv:2410.05229v2, stamped 27 Aug 2025. This v2 adds a statistics rebuttal (Appendix B) that the 2024 preprint lacks.

COVERAGE: 24 of 24 pages, 89,010 of 89,010 chars. Body p1-10, references p11-15 (skimmed for origins), appendices A.1-A.6 and B p16-24 read in full. Nothing skipped.

CLAIMS

- claim: Accuracy on the same 100 questions varies across 50 re-instantiations.
  number: Gemma2-9b-it 79.1 (±3.0) against 87.0 on the GSM8K originals; best-to-worst gap over 12 points, about 15 for Phi-3.5-mini.
  setup: 100 templates built from 100 randomly chosen GSM8K test questions, 50 samples each, giving 50 sets of 100. 8-shot CoT with the original GSM8K shots, greedy decoding, accuracy. The ± is never defined in the text; the prose treats it as a standard deviation over the 50 sets.
  quote: "for the Gemma2-9B, the gap between the worst performance and the best performance is more than 12%, while for Phi-3.5-mini, this gap is around 15%"
  where: p5-6, Fig. 2

- claim: The original-question score usually sits above the re-instantiated distribution, which the authors read as possible contamination.
  number: 21 of 25 models.
  setup: Same as above; baseline is the 100 original questions.
  quote: "often more than one standard deviation away from the center of the GSM-Symbolic performance distribution, frequently on the right side of the distribution (this holds for 21 out of 25 models). One explanation for this could be data contamination"
  where: p6

- claim: The drops are small for strong models and larger for small open ones.
  number: -0.3 (GPT-4o) to -9.2 (Mistral-7b-it-v0.1).
  setup: Fig. 3. The values match Table 1's full-test column minus Symbolic (95.2 to 94.9; 39.7 to 30.5), so the baseline appears to be the 1,319-question set, not the 100. That is my arithmetic; the paper does not say so.
  quote: "GPT-4o 95.2 95.0 94.4 (± 1.62) 94.9 ( ± 1.87) 93.9 ( ± 2.59) 88.0 ( ± 3.43) 63.1 (± 4.53)"
  where: p6 Fig. 3; p17 Table 1

- claim: Changing names moves scores less than changing numbers.
  number: Gemma2-9b-it: Names 88.6 (±2.0), Numbers 83.1 (±2.2), Both 79.1 (±3.0), GSM8K 87.0.
  setup: Fig. 4, six models, same protocol.
  quote: "the variance is lower when changing names compared to numbers"
  where: p7

- claim: Adding clauses lowers the mean and widens the spread.
  number: Gemma2-9b-it M1 84.4 (±2.4), Symbolic 79.1 (±3.0), P1 68.1 (±4.8), P2 41.8 (±6.0). GPT-4o 94.4, 94.9, 93.9, 88.0.
  setup: Fig. 6 and Table 1; one clause removed (M1), one or two added (P1, P2).
  quote: "as the difficulty increases, the performance decreases and the variance increases"
  where: p8

- claim: One irrelevant but plausible clause (GSM-NoOp) causes the largest drops.
  number: -65.7 points for Phi-3-mini (83.7 to 18.0), -32.0 for GPT-4o, -17.5 for o1-preview (94.9 to 77.4).
  setup: Fig. 8a, drop from full GSM8K, in percentage points. Eight shots of the same question (NoOp-Symb) do not recover it for Phi-3-medium (29.4 to 30.2) or Llama3-8b (18.6 to 19.6).
  quote: "the Phi-3-mini model experiencing over a 65% drop, and even stronger models such as o1-preview showing significant declines"
  where: p9-10

- claim: Arithmetic error does not explain the drops.
  number: Gemma2-9b-it in-response arithmetic accuracy 98.9 (GSM8K), 98.3 (Symbolic), 97.4 (P1), 97.1 (P2).
  setup: Table 2, equations extracted from generated answers.
  quote: "GSM-P2 96.2 98.6 97.5 96.4 99.2 97.1"
  where: p23

- claim: The authors concede the significance claim depends on the test chosen.
  number: none
  setup: They used a one-sample two-sided t-test of the 50 scores against the 100-question score; p<0.001 for most models, 0.13 for Llama3-8b, 0.6 for GPT-4o (Fig. 10).
  quote: "if one disagrees with our assumptions and accepts the assumptions of Ivanova et al. (2025), our results would likewise be statistically non-significant, as those authors have shown"
  where: p18, Appendix B p23-24

LIMITS
- Contamination is offered as "one explanation", never tested directly. There is no membership or training-data check.
- The baseline is a single score on 100 questions. Each set also has n=100, so a ±3 spread is about what binomial sampling gives at 80% (my calculation, roughly 4 points; the paper does not compute it). This is the core of the Ivanova et al. critique, which the paper cites but does not refute numerically.
- The spread is across instantiations under greedy decoding, not across seeds or runs. The o1 models are not greedy.
- Results are not uniform: Table 1 shows Llama3-8b-instruct 74.0 to 74.6 and o1-mini 93.0 to 94.5 on the 100-question baseline, which sits awkwardly with Fig. 3's "all models drop".
- Templates slightly widen the number ranges, so the Symbolic sets are not strictly equal in difficulty; the authors argue this is immaterial (A.6).
- "Not capable of genuine logical reasoning" is stated as a hypothesis.
- The model list is dated (largest open model 27B; o1-preview the strongest closed one).

BUILDS ON: Cobbe et al. (2021) GSM8K; Shi et al. (2023) GSM-IC, irrelevant context; Li et al. (2024a) GSM-Plus; Zhang et al. (2024) GSM1K, overfitting; Srivastava et al. (2024) functional MATH variants; Stolfo et al. (2023); Jiang et al. (2024) token bias; Ivanova et al. (2025) for the statistical critique.

CODE: Template spec, p2 Fig. 1: "#variables: - x = range(5, 100) ... #conditions: - x + y + z + ans == total". Prompt format, p16 Fig. 9.

FIGURES: Fig. 2, p6. Histograms of 50-set accuracy per model with the GSM8K score as a dashed line. It shows "a benchmark score is a draw from a distribution" in one glance and serves both notes.

PROBLEMS: Extraction is clean, with no embedded instructions. Fig. 3 bar labels are run together, so I re-paired them against Table 1. Table 1 has identical cells across several base and instruct pairs (Gemma2b, Gemma-7b, Llama3-8b), and Gemma2-9b M1 (71.2) is below Symbolic (79.1); these are possible table errors I could not resolve. Appendix B body footnote 5 has no visible marker.
